description: This file defines a PHP trait 'InsertTrait' that provides common functionality for constructing SQL INSERT and UPSERT queries within the Drupal core database abstraction layer.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Adds a set of field->value pairs to be inserted, initializing insert fields and values.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Adds another set of values to the insert query, either as a numeric array matching the insert fields or as an associative array that is reordered.

methods.name: useDefaults
methods.description: Specifies fields for which the database defaults should be used.

methods.name: getInsertPlaceholderFragment
methods.description: Generates placeholders for the insert query, handling default fields and multiple value sets.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of insert value sets added to the query.
